## Checklist

- [ ] Tests pass locally (`pnpm test` / `pytest`)
- [ ] Linting passes (`pnpm lint` / `ruff check`)
- [ ] Type checking passes (`pnpm typecheck` / `mypy`)
- [ ] Build succeeds (`pnpm build`)
- [ ] Documentation updated (if applicable)
- [ ] No `any` types without justification comment
- [ ] Quantum math verified against textbook reference (if applicable)
- [ ] No user input is executed as code (if touching evaluator/execution)
